math.degToRad = math.pi / 180
math.ragToDeg = 180 / math.pi

function math.clamp(value, min, max)
    return math.min(math.max(min, value), max)
end

function math.csRandom(min, max)
    return UnityEngine.Random.Range(min, max)
end

function math.mRandom(stdDev)
    local half = stdDev * 0.5
    return (math.random() * half  + math.random() * half) - half
end

---@param t number ratio 0-1
---@param c1 number
---@param c2 number
---@param c3 number
---@return number
function math.Bezier3(t, c1, c2, c3)
    local t1 = 1 - t
    return t1 * t1 * c1 + 2 * t1 * t * c2 + t * t * c3
end

local origin_randomseed = math.randomseed
function math.randomseed(seed)
    origin_randomseed(seed)
    for _ = 1, 4 do
        math.random()
    end
end

math.randomseed(os.time())
